newsitem.title: FRANCE: Naomi Campbell back at work after drug scare.
newsitem.headline: Naomi Campbell back at work after drug scare.

text.p: British model Naomi Campbell returned to work in Paris on Monday after receiving emergency treatment in a Canary Islands hospital, her agent said.
Xavier Moreau of Elite modelling agency, denying Campbell had been treated for a drug overdose, said she had suffered an allergy to antibiotics which she had taken for stomach pains.
"It was an allergy to antibiotics, she didn't take barbiturates," he told Reuters. "She has resumed her activities."

The 26-year-old model was taken semi-conscious from her five-star hotel on the Spanish island of Gran Canaria early on Sunday. An official at Nuestra Senora del Pino hospital said she was admitted to intensive care after "an overdose".
She left the hospital on Sunday evening and flew back to Paris by private plane.
Moreau said he had spoken to Campbell by telephone and "It's much ado about nothing. The proof is she is not in the hospital. At first we thought it was appendicitis. She had stomach cramps."

Local media on the Canary Islands reported that Campbell had had an argument with her boyfriend, 28-year-old flamenco dancer Joaquin Cortes, who is in Gran Canaria with his hugely successful "Gypsy Passion" dance show.

Campbell and Cortes had arrived on the island on the same plane on Friday but stayed in separate rooms at the luxury hotel, where residents complained late on Saturday about a heated conversation between the two, the local reports said.
Campbell then appeared extremely nervous and took some form of medicine, hotel staff told local media.

"She is not the type to suffer over love," Moreau said. He added that Campbell was posing in a photo shoot in Paris but declined to say where because "we don't want a horde of journalists showing up."

Campbell and Cortes had dated for several months but gossip magazines recently reported that the long-haired flamenco star, dubbed "sex on legs" for his steamy dancing, had broken up with Campbell. He was photographed with another woman on holiday in the southern resort of Marbella.

Campbell, who can earn tens of thousands of dollars for a morning's work, is the best known black model in the world and one of a tiny clique of supermodels like Claudia Schiffer and Cindy Crawford who have become household names.
She is due to appear in the haute couture collections in Paris in July.
She has had a string of famous boyfriends including U.S. actor Robert de Niro, and was once engaged to Adam Clayton of the Irish rock band U2.
